name: Explore and reset the mangrove scene
description: Explore the live mangrove backdrop, then return to the original composition.
steps: Open the scene and confirm trees, stilt roots, sky, and water are visible without a coin or hero advertisement
Drag the scene and scroll to zoom
Open ตั้งค่าฉาก and select กลับมุมมองเริ่มต้น
expected: The camera changes on interaction and resets to the original open-estuary view. The page has no horizontal overflow.

name: Change and retain the lighting preset
description: Lighting controls update the scene and preserve the user's selection.
steps: Open ตั้งค่าฉาก
Select กลางวัน, then แสงเย็น
Refresh the page without query-string overrides
Open settings and verify แสงเย็น remains selected
Press Escape
expected: The sky, light, and water change with the preset; evening remains selected after refresh. Escape closes settings and returns focus to the settings button.

name: Pause and navigate accessibly
description: Motion can be stopped while camera and accessibility controls remain usable.
steps: Select หยุดการเคลื่อนไหว
Focus the canvas and use arrow keys, plus/minus, and 0
Select เล่นการเคลื่อนไหว
Try เต็มหน้าจอ and leave it again
With the operating-system reduced-motion preference enabled, reload the page
expected: Automatic animation pauses and resumes; keyboard navigation and reset work. Fullscreen opens or displays a clear unsupported message. Reduced motion starts paused.

name: Mobile settings and quality selection
description: The mobile view and controls remain within the viewport at either quality level.
steps: Drag the scene using touch
Open ตั้งค่าฉาก
Change รายละเอียดภาพ to ประหยัดพลังงาน
Select แสงเช้า
Refresh the page
expected: The forest and water remain visible, controls are reachable without scrolling, and the quality preference survives refresh.

name: Graceful graphics failure and recovery
description: A failed graphics context never leaves a blank screen or endless loading overlay.
steps: Open the page with WebGL 2 unavailable
Confirm a fallback image and Thai explanation are visible and motion/reset/quality controls are disabled
In a WebGL-capable browser simulate context loss and restoration
Open the page with quality=invalid and light=invalid
expected: A usable static fallback is shown when 3D is unavailable. A restored context rebuilds the scene. Invalid query values fall back to supported defaults.
